                ~&425121728314878811&~.~&16765000136167945189&~.~&7081261925573&~ {
                    ~&5972374&~: smartRemarkableLlmButton
                    ~&481641799955318521&~: ~&5971598&~.~&233696851602406&~
                    ~&6504337259&~: ~&214642769434&~.~&6504337259&~
                    /* One pending mode shared by both buttons prevents a rapid*/

                    property ~&7083178290016&~ pendingMode: ""

                            smartRemarkableLlmButton.clearPendingMode()
                        }
                    }

                    /* AppLoad's launcher API has no completion callback. If*/
                    /* startup or pre-acceptance transport fails, keep the*/
                    /* selection visible but release the UI guard after a*/
                    /* bounded interval so the same lasso can be retried.*/
                    ~&214604601930&~ {
                        ~&5972374&~: smartRemarkablePendingReset
                        ~&7713147298280334&~: 45000
                        ~&7083121289162&~: ~&214625660372&~
                        ~&495358363329399331&~: smartRemarkableLlmButton.clearPendingMode()
                    }

                    /* The worker sends this private chord only after the*/

                    /* Calling the stock close() path clears selection state*/
                    /* without copying or deleting the underlying strokes.*/
                    ~&7712201763518885&~ {
                        ~&233726547792244&~: smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingMode !== "" && ~&10742505294233322867&~.~&233748328658231&~

                        ~&495331016591073787&~: {
                            /* Release the guard before close() changes visibility.*/
                            /* This also disables the shortcut immediately, so a*/
                            /* delayed chord cannot affect the next selection.*/
                            smartRemarkableLlmButton.clearPendingMode()
                            ~&5971598&~.~&254524858248187773&~(function() {
                                ~&5972376&~ (~&10742505294233322867&~.~&233748328658231&~) {
                                    ~&10742505294233322867&~.~&214622501183&~()
                                }
                            })
                        }
                    }

                    function clearPendingMode() {
                        smartRemarkablePendingReset.~&6504295855&~()
                        pendingMode = ""
                    }

                    function requestMode(~&6504074414&~) {
                        ~&5972376&~ (pendingMode !== "") {
                            ~&7083121450889&~
                        }
                        ~&5972376&~ (~&6504074414&~ !== "write_back" &&
                                ~&6504074414&~ !== "whatsapp_only") {

                        }
                        pendingMode = ~&6504074414&~
                        smartRemarkablePendingReset.~&233743006639214&~()
                        ~&5972376&~ (!launch(~&6504074414&~)) {
                            clearPendingMode()
                        }
                    }

                    function launch(~&6504074414&~) {
                        /* Resolve AppLoad only when tapped. Keeping the module*/

                        /* selection component keep loading if AppLoad is ever*/

                        ~&197102514&~ helper = ~&6504117156&~
                        try {
                            helper = ~&5971598&~.createQmlObject(
                                'import QtQuick;\n' +

                                ~&10742505294233322867&~,
                                "smart_remarkable_appload_launcher"
                            )
                            ~&5972376&~ (helper) {

                                ~&7083121450889&~ ~&6504329801&~
                            } ~&6503784146&~ {
                                ~&7083121450889&~ ~&214625660372&~
                            }
                        } catch (~&214625091795&~) {
                            ~&233724020023100&~.~&6504419009&~("Smart Remarkable launcher unavailable")
                            ~&5972376&~ (helper) {
                                helper.~&233724926106067&~()
                            }
                            ~&7083121450889&~ ~&214625660372&~

                    }

                }
